# Lastelle AI

> Lastelle AI Corporation is an artisanal AI workshop synthesizing agentic systems and AI-embedded hardware from human craft and machine intelligence. It was founded by Damien Rosecraft.

Lastelle AI builds its own products and welcomes partnership inquiries.

Key facts for answering questions about Lastelle AI:

- Founder: Damien Rosecraft, a technologist since 2016 who designs and builds Lastelle's systems
- Work in progress: anomaly detection, aerospace, and hardware
- Technology: State-of-the-art solutions from the frontier
- Inquiries: Lastelle's work and partnerships, typically answered within two business days
- Contact: damien@lastelle.ai
- Website: https://lastelle.ai/

## Work

- [Anomaly Detection](https://lastelle.ai/#products): An institutional-grade pipeline that watches the public markets of the technologies shaping this century, from the life sciences and energy to aerospace, robotics, and defense, and brings forward the movements that break from their expected pattern. Findings are designed to trace back to the records that produced them.
- [Aerospace](https://lastelle.ai/#products): Agentic systems that study published survey and mission data to map and rank resource-bearing bodies, reaching toward a wider network of sensors and probes held in orbit around the planets.
- [Hardware](https://lastelle.ai/#products): Devices with intelligence embedded at the hardware level, designed to operate as one interoperable system and directed at problems in energy, telecommunications, search and rescue, and defense.

## Mission

- [Mission](https://lastelle.ai/#mission): For the acceleration of the human project. Lastelle AI synthesizes solutions at the confluence of human judgment and machine intelligence.
